standards: Accurate — every factual claim must be verifiable against a real source.
Unbiased — no partisan framing, no personal opinion presented as fact.
Fair — all relevant parties get appropriate representation before a claim about them runs.
Evidence-based — no claim without a supporting source.
Neutral in tone — no sensational language, no manufactured drama.
Properly attributed — every claim traceable to where it came from.
No fabricated facts, quotes, sources, or URLs, ever, under any circumstance.
No unsupported speculation presented as fact — clearly label claims vs. confirmed fact.
No sensationalism used to drive engagement.
Businesses and individuals are never portrayed unfairly or out of context.
Content must be recent and genuinely relevant — never manufactured to fill a quota.
Sources are linked naturally at the point of use, never dumped in a trailing list.
